caps:
A web page told an AI agent
to pay $45 to a stranger.

AgentPurse said no. PayPal
was never called.

AgentPurse sits between an
AI agent and PayPal.

The agent can only propose a
payment, over MCP.

Plain rules decide: pay, ask
a human, or deny.

Every decision lands in a
tamper-evident log.

This is a real Claude,
running live through MCP.
It checks the budget,

then proposes $12 to an
allowed supplier.

Approved: a mock PayPal
order opens. No keys yet.

$30 is over the limit, so it
waits for a person.
For a forbidden gift card,

Claude asks the dry-run tool
first, hears no, and stops.
